    num_ordinal_heads = 4

    # Preprocessing & Augmentation
    use_graham_norm = False  # Disabled (Cite Lesson 31: Avoid heuristic preprocessing with modern backbones)

    aug_vflip = True
    aug_rotate90 = True
    aug_color_jitter = False  # Disabled to preserve color-specific lesions

    # =======================
    # Training Configuration
    # =======================

    train_batch_size = 32  # Increased for A100 (Cite Lesson 7: Healthy batch size for BN stability)
